en.text: Give thanks to the LORD! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.

footnotes.text: 105:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

zhSimplified.text: 你们要称谢耶和华，求告他的名，

zhTraditional.text: 你們要稱謝耶和華， 求告他的名，

en.text: Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.

zhSimplified.text: 要向他唱诗歌颂，

zhTraditional.text: 要向他唱詩歌頌，

en.text: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice.

zhSimplified.text: 要以他的圣名夸耀！

zhTraditional.text: 要以他的聖名誇耀！

en.text: Seek the LORD and his strength. Seek his face forever more.

zhSimplified.text: 要寻求耶和华与他的能力，

zhTraditional.text: 要尋求耶和華與他的能力，

en.text: Remember his marvelous works that he has done: his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,

zhSimplified.text: 他仆人的后裔， 的子孙哪，

zhTraditional.text: 他僕人的後裔， 的子孫哪，

en.text: you offspring of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
He is the LORD, our God. His judgments are in all the earth.

zhSimplified.text: 他是耶和华—我们的 神；

zhTraditional.text: 他是耶和華－我們的上帝；

en.text: He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,

zhSimplified.text: 他记念他的约，直到永远；

zhTraditional.text: 他記念他的約，直到永遠；

en.text: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac,

zhSimplified.text: 就是与所立的， 所起的誓。

zhTraditional.text: 就是與所立的， 所起的誓。

en.text: and confirmed it to Jacob for a statute; to Israel for an everlasting covenant,

zhSimplified.text: 他又将这约向定为律例， 定为永远的约，

zhTraditional.text: 他又將這約向定為律例， 定為永遠的約，

en.text: saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance,”

zhSimplified.text: 说：我必将地赐给你，

zhTraditional.text: 說：我必將地賜給你，

en.text: when they were but a few men in number, very few, and foreigners in it.

zhSimplified.text: 当时，他们人丁有限，数目稀少，

zhTraditional.text: 當時，他們人丁有限，數目稀少，

en.text: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.

zhSimplified.text: 他们从这邦游到那邦，

zhTraditional.text: 他們從這邦遊到那邦，

en.text: He allowed no one to do them wrong. he reproved kings for their sakes,

zhSimplified.text: 他不容什么人欺负他们，

zhTraditional.text: 他不容甚麼人欺負他們，

en.text: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”

zhSimplified.text: 说：不可难为我受膏的人，

zhTraditional.text: 說：不可難為我受膏的人，

en.text: He called for a famine on the land. He destroyed the food supplies.

zhSimplified.text: 他命饥荒降在那地上，

zhTraditional.text: 他命饑荒降在那地上，

en.text: He sent a man before them. Joseph was sold for a slave.

zhSimplified.text: 在他们以先打发一个人去 被卖为奴仆。

zhTraditional.text: 在他們以先打發一個人去 被賣為奴僕。

en.text: They bruised his feet with shackles. His neck was locked in irons,

zhSimplified.text: 人用脚镣伤他的脚； 捆拘。

zhTraditional.text: 人用腳鐐傷他的腳； 捆拘。

en.text: until the time that his word happened, and the LORD’s word proved him true.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华的话试炼他，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華的話試煉他，

en.text: The king sent and freed him, the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.

zhSimplified.text: 王打发人把他解开，

zhTraditional.text: 王打發人把他解開，

en.text: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all of his possessions,

zhSimplified.text: 立他作王家之主，

zhTraditional.text: 立他作王家之主，

en.text: to discipline his princes at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom.

zhSimplified.text: 使他随意捆绑他的臣宰，

zhTraditional.text: 使他隨意捆綁他的臣宰，

en.text: Israel also came into Egypt. Jacob lived in the land of Ham.

zhSimplified.text: 也到了； 在地寄居。

zhTraditional.text: 也到了； 在地寄居。

en.text: He increased his people greatly, and made them stronger than their adversaries.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华使他的百姓生养众多，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華使他的百姓生養眾多，

en.text: He turned their heart to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.

zhSimplified.text: 使敌人的心转去恨他的百姓，

zhTraditional.text: 使敵人的心轉去恨他的百姓，

en.text: He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.

zhSimplified.text: 他打发他的仆人 ，

zhTraditional.text: 他打發他的僕人 ，

en.text: They performed miracles among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

zhSimplified.text: 在敌人中间显他的神迹， 地显他的奇事。

zhTraditional.text: 在敵人中間顯他的神蹟， 地顯他的奇事。

en.text: He sent darkness, and made it dark. They didn’t rebel against his words.

zhSimplified.text: 他命黑暗，就有黑暗；

zhTraditional.text: 他命黑暗，就有黑暗；

en.text: He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish.

zhSimplified.text: 他叫的水变为血，

zhTraditional.text: 他叫的水變為血，

en.text: Their land swarmed with frogs, in the rooms of their kings.

zhSimplified.text: 在他们的地上以及王宫的内室，

zhTraditional.text: 在他們的地上以及王宮的內室，

en.text: He spoke, and swarms of flies came, and lice in all their borders.

zhSimplified.text: 他说一声，苍蝇就成群而来，

zhTraditional.text: 他說一聲，蒼蠅就成群而來，

en.text: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning in their land.

zhSimplified.text: 他给他们降下冰雹为雨，

zhTraditional.text: 他給他們降下冰雹為雨，

en.text: He struck their vines and also their fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country.

zhSimplified.text: 他也击打他们的葡萄树和无花果树，

zhTraditional.text: 他也擊打他們的葡萄樹和無花果樹，

en.text: He spoke, and the locusts came the grasshoppers, without number.

zhSimplified.text: 他说一声，就有蝗虫蚂蚱上来，

zhTraditional.text: 他說一聲，就有蝗蟲螞蚱上來，

en.text: They ate up every plant in their land, and ate up the fruit of their ground.

zhSimplified.text: 吃尽了他们地上各样的菜蔬

zhTraditional.text: 吃盡了他們地上各樣的菜蔬

en.text: He struck also all the firstborn in their land, the first fruits of all their manhood.

zhSimplified.text: 他又击杀他们国内一切的长子，

zhTraditional.text: 他又擊殺他們國內一切的長子，

en.text: He brought them out with silver and gold. was not one feeble person among his tribes.

zhSimplified.text: 他领自己的百姓带银子金子出来；

zhTraditional.text: 他領自己的百姓帶銀子金子出來；

en.text: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the fear of them had fallen on them.

zhSimplified.text: 他们出来的时候，人便欢喜； 人惧怕他们。

zhTraditional.text: 他們出來的時候，人便歡喜； 人懼怕他們。

en.text: He spread a cloud for a covering, to give light in the night.

zhSimplified.text: 他铺张云彩当遮盖，

zhTraditional.text: 他鋪張雲彩當遮蓋，

en.text: They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of the sky.

zhSimplified.text: 他们一求，他就使鹌鹑飞来，

zhTraditional.text: 他們一求，他就使鵪鶉飛來，

en.text: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out. ran as a river in the dry places.

zhSimplified.text: 他打开磐石，水就涌出；

zhTraditional.text: 他打開磐石，水就湧出；

en.text: For he remembered his holy word, and Abraham, his servant.

zhSimplified.text: 这都因他记念他的圣言 。

zhTraditional.text: 這都因他記念他的聖言 。

en.text: He brought his people out with joy, his chosen with singing.

zhSimplified.text: 他带领百姓欢乐而出，

zhTraditional.text: 他帶領百姓歡樂而出，

en.text: He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession,

zhSimplified.text: 他将列国的地赐给他们，

zhTraditional.text: 他將列國的地賜給他們，

en.text: that they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Praise the LORD!

zhSimplified.text: 好使他们遵他的律例，

zhTraditional.text: 好使他們遵他的律例，
